Making of Constitution: 1st proposed by M.N. Roy (1934). Constituent Assembly formed under Cabinet Mission (1946). Chairman : Rajendra Prasad. Drafting Head : B.R. Ambedkar. Borrowed Features: USA (FR, Preamble). UK (Parliamentary). Ireland (DPSP). USSR (Duties). South Africa (Amendment). The Preamble: "Identity Card" of the Constitution (N.A. Palkhivala). topic_title: TNPSC Polity: Making of Constitution & Preamble
lesson_intro: Today we study the 'Foundation of Democracy'. Indian Polity in TNPSC is factual and focuses on 'Borrowed features' and 'Schedules'. From the Drafting Committee to the 42nd Amendment—these are the structural markers. Do you know who was the first person to propose a Constituent Assembly? Let's master the foundation today.
